tables.title: the rows this gate ran
rows: 1 THE DISTANCES ARE 64-BIT (32-bit made the stale-entry skip fail and the search run without end)
2 THE ROCK BLOCKS ITS REACH, AND NO FURTHER (rock radius + fighter radius + margin + 0.87 cell)
0 cells inside the reach free, 0 outside it blocked
3 THE GOAL IS EVERY FREE CELL WITHIN goalR OF THE ORIGIN, AT DISTANCE 0
4 THE DISTANCES ARE THE 26-NEIGHBOUR SHORTEST PATHS (against a plain O(n^2) Dijkstra here)
5 A SEGMENT THROUGH A ROCK IS NOT CLEAR; ONE WIDE OF IT IS
6 BESIDE THE ROCK, WITH THE WAY HOME HIDDEN, THE AIM IS IN CLEAR SIGHT, FREE, AND BEYOND THE FIRST STEP
6b DIRECTLY BEHIND IT, WHERE EVERY LINE CLIPS THE BLOCKED CORNER, THE AIM IS THE ADJACENT DESCENT CELL, MARKED NEAR -- NEVER NULL (the 2026-11-25 amendment)
7 IN OPEN SPACE THE AIM IS THE FARTHEST CELL IN SIGHT: A GOAL CELL
8 THE HAND-BACK: INSIDE THE STRAFE RANGE THE PILOT IS AP.decide(body, target, opts), EXACTLY
9 OUTSIDE IT THE PILOT FLIES AP.decide TOWARD THE AIM, AT REST (with a weapon speed and a moving target, so the aim's velocity is read)
the fixture tells the velocities apart: true
10 THE STRAFE RANGE IS MEASURED TO THE SHIP'S CURRENT CENTRE, NOT THE FIELD'S ORIGIN
11 THE AIM IS CACHED FOR `every` TICKS, THEN RECOMPUTED
12 ON A REAL FIELD EVERY ROCK'S CENTRE CELL IS BLOCKED AND THE SHIP'S IS A GOAL CELL
13 PURE: NO Math.random, NO CLOCK, NO I/O IN THE MODULE
14 THE LANE: every lane goal cell is free, within goalR, and has a clear line to the origin
15 THE LANE REACHES THE FIELD: the plain field has goal cells with the line blocked, and the lane field drops exactly those
16 THE LANE IS OFF BY DEFAULT: Round A's field, to the bit
17 THE FOLLOWING FIELD: built at the first call round the ship, the same field until `every` ticks have passed, then rebuilt round where the ship is NOW
18 THE PILOT TAKES A FIELD-GIVING FUNCTION, AND NEVER REUSES AN AIM CACHED UNDER ANOTHER FIELD
19 THE CAP: the wrapped pilot's thrust is 0 at or over the cap's closing speed to the nearest foe, untouched below it and with no foe, and nothing else changes
20 AN EMPTY LANE FALLS BACK TO THE PLAIN GOAL (the origin's own cell blocked) and says so; a lane that is not empty is untouched and does not say so
origin blocked true, laneEmpty true, goal cells 188 (plain 188); the fixture of rows 14-16 laneEmpty false
NAV_DEFAULTS are the registration's settings: cells of 16 in a cube of half-width 560 (70 a side), margin 20, re-aimed every 15 ticks, no lane (brain/ROCK_NAV_WIP.md)
shipOf finds the arena's capital ship, not the first craft, and nothing in an arena without one
the real arena's ship is craft 1
reportLines says what the layer is and prints the defaults it flies with
cell 16, half-width 560, margin 20, re-aim every 15 ticks
